description: cAgents plugin marketplace - 213 agents, 8 commands, 8 business domains. Multi-agent orchestration for software engineering, creative writing, business operations, and more.

plugins.name: cagents
plugins.description: 213 agents across 8 business domains (Engineering, Creative, Business, Growth, People, Service, Leadership, Shared). 8 commands: /run (implement anything — auto-detects domain, selects controllers, delegates to specialist agents), /team (parallel N-wave execution for complex tasks, 40-60% faster), /org (cross-domain strategic initiatives with C-suite analysis and deliberation), /designer (interactive 6-phase design with guided Q&A), /review (quality audits with parallel reviewers and auto-fix), /optimize (performance optimization with before/after metrics and rollback), /helper (interactive command guide), /context (shared product context across sessions). Controller-centric delegation with reviewer loops across all workflows.
